regions.today: Dry today with sunshine, hazy at times. Highest temperatures of 20 to 26 degrees in light, occasionally moderate northerly breezes.
regions.tonight: Dry with long clear spells tonight. Lowest temperatures of 8 to 13 degrees in mostly light northerly breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Turning rather cloudy over the northern half of the province tomorrow morning with a few spots of drizzle possible. Dry with sunny spells further south. Through the afternoon and evening, the cloud will break up to sunny spells. Highest temperatures of 20 to 24 degrees with light northerly breezes.
